title: Micro Raiders : Need people to play my extraction fantasy browser game (claude/godot)
author: UnknownCitizen7
selftext:
Hi guys!

I'm looking for a few players/testers for my top-down pixel art fantasy extraction looter, playable directly in the browser (executable available too):



[https://urls.fr/zcRMmz](https://urls.fr/zcRMmz) (and you can join the Discord too)

I need people to find bugs and tell me what feels off. There are about 20 new spots open right now. It's in alpha. 



\> Go into a random dungeon, fight monsters and other players, loot, and get out alive with your gear.

It's completely free btw.



\*\*What's in it so far:\*\*

\- PvPvE matches (20 min): 2 to 5 players solo, or up to 5 duos, plus a temporary PvE mode you can play solo or as a duo

\- The Pit: waves of enemies, round after round, in 3 random arenas with lava and traps, with a leaderboard

\- 3 classes (warrior, archer, mage), each with 3 skills and its own gear

\- Randomly generated dungeons: libraries, chests and corpses to search, traps and boss

\- Stealth: darkness hides you, your lantern gives you away, monsters hear your steps (and doors)

\- Loot in 4 rarities, gems to socket, gear that wears out and needs repairs

\- Gathering (plants, mushrooms, ore, fishing) and crafting: potions, grenades, repairs, gem enchanting

\- A hub with a stash, a merchant with a rotating shop, daily and weekly missions, achievements and titles

\- Chat, friends, private messages, profiles, and duo parties

\- English and French



I'm a solo dev and I build it with Claude and Godot since almost 3 months.
